_about: Seed ranges already used per world (inclusive [lo, hi]). New TEST seeds must be disjoint from their world's list; harnesses assert this and record this file's sha256. Built 2026-09-25 from a repo scan (scripts/, cdd_oran/, scratchpad/, tests/) plus frozen protocols. Sub-stream keys combined with a seed (e.g. 909090, 424242, 313131, 191919, 700002, 777001, 2999, 29990) are RNG stream tags, not env/corpus seeds, and are listed separately. A study's own TEST range is listed under its world's 'claimed_by' (and in 'used'); that study's harness excludes only its own claim when asserting disjointness. Updated 2026-09-26: Stage 0 test seeds added; E5_NOISE_DETECT claimed.

TEST seeds must be drawn from >= 960000 and registered here when the E6 protocol is frozen; none used yet. 2026-09-28: DEV policy 100000-100179 and probe 110000-110179 reserved (see dev_reserved).

dev_reserved.mapping: seed = base + 30*stratum + j; base = 100000 (policy, collector v2) | 110000 (probe); stratum = 2*scenario_idx + load_idx with scenarios (base, surge, mistune) and loads (medium, high) -> 0 base-medium, 1 base-high, 2 surge-medium, 3 surge-high, 4 mistune-medium, 5 mistune-high; j = 0..29, j < 20 fit, j >= 20 untouched diagnostics. Implemented as cdd_oran.decision.collect.dev_seed / dev_stratum. Paired accept-all / no-probe reference episodes reuse the episode seed (same plant tape).
